PluginInfo.Name: VNC (based on Chicken)
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Connect to Windows, macOS and Linux using VNC.
PluginInfo.Description:
Connect to Windows, macOS and Linux Computers running VNC or Apple Remote Desktop.

The Chicken based VNC plugin enables you to connect to remote hosts running VNC or Apple Remote Desktop.

Security
  • VNC authentication support
  • Apple Remote Desktop/Screen Sharing authentication support
  • UltraVNC MS-Logon II authentication support

Advanced Features
  • Clipboard sharing support
  • Screen scaling support
  • Customizable keyboard behavior
  • JPEG and CopyRect encoding support
  • Secure Gateway support
